FIGURE III-6
CROW AGENCY POPULATION AND HOUSEHOLD 1975-2000 Converging Participation Rates (LFPR-2)
Lodge Grass would be expected to experience a somewhat greater increase if development on the Shell lease occurs in the forseeable future (AF-2). If this does occur, services and housing in Lodge Grass will need to be significantly expanded.
Lodge Grass and Wyola will feel appreciable population impacts only if coal development occurs in areas much nearer than Westmoreland's operation. Even if housing and services were made available, Westmoreland's development can be expected to have no population impact on Lodge Grass because of its distance from the mining site.
